summary: `posted_date` is a day-granular English date string whose day field is space-padded, so any parse must collapse whitespace first and any recency window must be inclusive by whole date rather than by clock.
reason: amazon.jobs renders single-digit days with a second space ("May  9, 2026"), which the natural "January 2, 2006" layout rejects; that shape is roughly 19% of live rows, so a naive parse silently drops every req posted on the 1st through the 9th of a month. The field also carries no time component, so a clock-anchored cutoff would drop reqs posted earlier in the day at the far edge of the window and imply a precision the API does not provide.
validated_outcome: `find --posted-within 7d --dry-run` reports the resolved inclusive floor; unit tests pin the double-space form and the cutoff-day-is-inside boundary.
